verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents a dedicated official CLI explicitly for AI agents/scripts ('The Customer.io CLI is a command-line tool that gives AI agents and scripts full access to your Customer.io workspaces') along with installable 'skills' to teach AI assistants to use it. This directly satisfies the ai-native CLI story with first-party docs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of the CLI's actual usage and broader detail on install/command surface beyond the docs snippet.
